selectionLabel: run.mjs contains a pre-run comment describing a large-minute reserve. The selected Payton Pritchard source card actually started 50 of 79 games in 2025-26. The actual starts are reported; no starter/bench label enters the workload or reliability formula. The frozen selection and results are retained.
historicalMinuteField: The frozen workload-source.json field primaryBenchmarkMinutes belongs to the original recurrent-injury-as-minutes diagnostic hypothesis. It is NOT the selected main rating policy. The CSV names it injuryMinutesDiagnosticOnly. The selected policy is src/player_reliability.js and reliability-policy.json: keep healthy rotation, discount only positive contribution, never award absence points.
protocolScope: protocol.json preregisters the four rotation experiment arms. The subsequent selected contribution-discount policy is separately documented and tested; it is not falsely described as preregistered clinical validation or a completed OVR.
